_about: Corrections to @vscode/web-custom-data where it disagrees with the HTML standard. Each entry says why. valueSet v = boolean attribute; b = true/false enumerated; valueless = a value attribute that is also valid with no value; exclude = not generated.

autofocus._why: boolean attribute per HTML 'The autofocus attribute is a boolean attribute'

inert._why: boolean attribute per HTML 'The inert attribute is a boolean attribute'

download._why: an empty download attribute is valid: download with the server's file name
an empty download attribute is valid: download with the server's file name

text._why: non-conforming presentational color; would also shadow ContainerTag.withText (use CSS color)
a DOM property, not a content attribute; would shadow ContainerTag.withText, which sets the script body

sandbox._why: an empty sandbox attribute is valid and applies every restriction

value.description: The text this field holds, which the server keeps deciding (ADR 0013, ADR 0034). Rendered as the element's text, as Solid 2 does: a textarea has no value attribute. Null clears it.
value._why: Solid 2's textarea.value: binding a textarea reads like binding an input

default-value.description: The text this field starts with, which is the user's from then on. Rendered as the element's text, the same as textarea(text).
default-value._why: Solid 2's textarea.defaultValue; the hyphen makes the builder withDefaultValue

rel.description: Controls the annotations and what kinds of links the form creates.
rel._why: the HTML standard defines rel on form; the data lacks it
